sentences.ar: وهو راجع، شاف بنت بشعر أصفر.
sentences.en: On his way back, he saw a girl with yellow hair.
She was standing in the garden of a new house.

sentences.ar: وقف قدامها وصار يعمل حركات غبية.
sentences.en: He stood in front of her and started doing silly tricks.
He walked on his hands and turned over.
She did not say a single word.

sentences.ar: قبل ما تدخل، رمت له وردة.
sentences.en: Before she went in, she threw him a flower.
Tom took the flower and put it in his shirt.
